title: SO101 digital sister editor
coordinateFrame: SO101 URDF base_link, meters, Z up

background.role: Editor context from the desk capture; not part of recorded policy observations
background.encoding: SPZ v3; full SH3 with no optional 5/4-bit SH reduction; 16 fractional position bits. Numerical quantization is explicit; the original PLY is unchanged.
background.registration: Saved Scope parent background transform applied once. The older desk_capture.transform is provenance only and is not composed with this transform.

displayAlignment.reason: Both supplied photographs show both bases bolted to the black perforated plate, with the complete plate tucked toward the back/wall edge. Shift the entire displayed rig 85mm toward world -X; do not move the arms off their plate.
displayAlignment.status: Presentation-only photo and Gaussian-capture estimate; source transforms, joint poses, camera records and evaluation scores remain unchanged.
displayAlignment.scope: Presentation-only placement of the complete CAD rig, camera props, task objects and lights in the captured desk; each arm base receives the local yaw correction about its unchanged base position. Both bases remain on the black plate.
displayAlignment.sourcePreservation: All original source transforms, joints, scene layouts, dimensions and scores remain unchanged in their original fields.

robotPoseSource: Saved Scope editing context, not the archived evaluation start pose.

camera.purpose: Free presentation view from the captured side of the desk; the viewer fits the rig along this direction. Not an exact source or policy camera pose.

external_left.render_correction_provenance: Native fiducials v5/v6/v7: installed RTX ignores vertical aperture and render-product aspect; central vertical crop required. Complete pixel audit mandatory.

measured_rgb_response.source: Current before_238 real patches vs native_preview02; simulator camera response only. Never apply to physical feeds.

external_right.render_correction_provenance: Native fiducials v5/v6/v7: installed RTX ignores vertical aperture and render-product aspect; central vertical crop required. Complete pixel audit mandatory.

measured_rgb_response.source: Current before_238 real patches vs native_preview02; simulator camera response only. Never apply to physical feeds.

left_wrist.render_correction_provenance: Native fiducials v5/v6/v7: installed RTX ignores vertical aperture and render-product aspect; central vertical crop required. Complete pixel audit mandatory.

measured_rgb_response.source: Current before_238 real patches vs native_preview02; simulator camera response only. Never apply to physical feeds.

cameraPropSource.visualApproximation: Photo-referenced NexiGo-style black housings, front grille, lens and status LED, hinged monitor clip, ball head, telescopic articulated pole, screw clamp, adjustment knobs and cables. Dimensions and support placement are visual estimates; these are not manufacturer CAD or calibrated mount geometry.
cameraPropSource.coordinateFrame: All meshes are rig-local and receive displayAlignment once; their prop transforms are identity. Do not reapply policy camera extrinsics.

limitations: Original Scope CAD and saved editor robot poses provide interactive editing context, not trajectory replay or a claimed recorded start.
The 54 displayed object transforms/dimensions and lighting rigs match the exact saved 30k-policy Scope response.
The table transform/size and camera records come from the recovered baseline file, verified against its recorded SHA256.
Browser lighting approximates Isaac RTX; measured camera response/distortion are recorded as provenance, not reproduced by the free-orbit view.
The complete original desk capture is delivered as quantized SPZ with full SH3; source PLY remains unchanged. Numerical diagnostics and a same-view browser review are retained.
The saved Scope background registration provides editor context, not recorded policy observations.
A separate estimated display alignment squares the CAD plate and arm bases with the captured rack; this is not physical calibration and does not alter source transforms or scores.
External camera housings and support arms are photo-referenced visual estimates; their optical poses match the archived baseline, but support geometry is not calibrated or manufacturer CAD.
Interactive scene viewing does not change the archived scores.

background/shell-desk-full.spz.role: Complete SH3 capture encoded as reviewed quantized SPZ for browser delivery.

cameras/external_left-camera-mount.glb.role: Photo-referenced presentation geometry; archived optical pose, estimated housing and mount.
